query: Native redesign of a read-only research workbench web app (React 19 + Vite): research-direction overview home, direction and hypothesis research report with verdict evidence, shared library, ordinary runs list and multi-run compare, and experiment analysis reorganised into linked data-visualisation surfaces (lineage tree, progress small multiples, solution-space embeddings incl. 3D, contest) with a persistent program inspector showing code and diffs; dark and light themes, Chinese-first CJK typography, desktop-first and fully readable on phones; award-level visual and interaction craft
